text:
The evidence doesn't confirm tree-cover loss on this property in 2020, but it doesn't rule it out either.

Hansen/UMD satellite data mapped about 0.7 ha of loss in 2020 (0.02% of the 3,643.5 ha property). However, the independent JRC 2020 reference map classed none of that area as forest (0% agreement, against a required 50%). So the assessment is "contradicted."

Context: the 2021 national forest map shows the affected area was 0.4 ha planted pine, 0.3 ha outside mapped forest, and no native forest. Hansen also detected another 1.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which weren't counted as an event.

Limits: the evidence can't show that no loss occurred, and it can't tell us whether this was deforestation or land-use change, since Hansen loss includes plantation harvest. It also can't identify the cause.
